lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The primary visible column contains three large-diameter maxima with approximately equidistant vertical spacing, followed by a second column of similar arrangement further posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs. These stripes act as vertical axes, with the blobs positioned as nodes at regular intervals along these axes to form a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, beginning posterior to the gills. They exhibit a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and a shadow effect on the ventral edge.
